welcome: Welcome, Plant Care Captain! Choose a plant friend.
chosen: Hello, little sprout! Let's help you grow.
water-intro: The soil looks dry. Bring the watering can to the pot.
water-nudge: The thirsty soil is waiting for a little drink.
water-done: Just right! Look how tall your plant grew.
mist-intro: Tap the mister over the leaves. Soft little clouds!
mist-nudge: The leaves are ready for a gentle mist.
mist-done: Fresh and shiny! Your plant feels bright.
prune-intro: The dry leaves are ready to come off. Give each one a gentle snip.
prune-nudge: Find a curly brown leaf for the shears.
prune-done: Snip, snip, hooray! A new bud is peeking out.
thriving: Look how happy your plant is! Your caring hands helped it bloom.
enough: That's enough for now. Gentle care is just right.
